Subject (in full) Michael Doll

Made by D.I. Papp Forwarded by Supt. Quayle

Michael Doll, British, 44, arrived in Shanghai from Hongkong on S/S "President Coolidge" on April 28, 1933 under the assumed name of Rath Harland, 44, claiming to be a citizen of U.S.A. On arrival, he failed to produce a passport but identified himself as Rath Harland with a Seamen Certificate, which bore no photograph and purported to be issued at New York. He gave his address on the Baggage Declaration Form as 212 Szechuen Road.

Michael Doll has been employed for the past several years as an occasional help-out at Jimmy's Restaruant, 212 Szechuen Road.

E. Papp
D.I.

事由（全称） Michael Doll

由警探帕普（Papp）呈报，经警司奎尔（Quayle）转呈

Michael Doll，英国人，44岁，于1933年4月28日乘“柯立芝总统号”轮船（S/S "President Coolidge"）从香港抵达上海，使用化名 Rath Harland，44岁，自称是美国公民。抵达时，他未能出示护照，而是以一份海员证书证明其身份为 Rath Harland，该证书上没有照片，声称是在纽约签发的。他在行李申报单上填写的地址是四川路212号。

Michael Doll 在过去几年里一直在四川路212号的吉米餐馆（Jimmy's Restaruant）做临时帮工。

E. 帕普（Papp）
